prompt:
Rewrite snippets/store-locator-entry-2.liquid so it renders one store-locator result card and handles null and empty-string inputs correctly. Input: one top-level variable `store`. It is always an object and always has all of these keys: - `name`, `address_line1`, `address_line2`, `city`, `postal_code`, `phone`: each a string or null. - `distance_km`: a number (integer or float) or null. Normalisation: treat null strings as empty strings and strip leading and trailing whitespace from every string field. A field is "blank" if it is empty after stripping. Rules: 1. If the stripped name is blank, output nothing (an empty string). 2. Otherwise output `
`, then `

NAME

`, then the optional parts below in this exact order, then `
`. 3. Address. Build up to three lines in this order: - the stripped address_line1, if not blank; - the stripped address_line2, if not blank; - a city line. If both the stripped postal_code and the stripped city are non-blank, it is `POSTAL CITY` (single space between). If only one is non-blank, it is that one alone, with no extra space. If both are blank, there is no city line. If at least one line exists, output `
` followed by each line as `LINE`, then `
`. If no line exists, omit the address element entirely. 4. Phone. If the stripped phone is not blank, output `

PHONE

`. PHONE is the stripped phone. TEL is the stripped phone with every space, hyphen `-`, `(` and `)` removed; all other characters such as `+` are kept. 5. Distance. If distance_km is null, omit this part. If it is less than 1, output `

Under 1 km away

`. This includes 0. Otherwise output `

N km away

`, where N is distance_km rounded to the nearest whole number, with halves rounded up (2.5 gives 3, 12.4 gives 12, 1 gives 1), printed with no decimals. 6. All printed text is HTML-escaped with the core `escape` filter. This covers NAME, each LINE, PHONE and TEL (& becomes &, < becomes <, > becomes >, " becomes "). 7. The output must contain no whitespace or newlines between tags. Use whitespace control so the result is a single line. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/store-locator-entry-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
